title: NyayAssist to roll out 10+ upgrades in June, keeping lawyers at the centre as Supreme Court’s AI draft takes shape
description: NyayAssist, a Mumbai-based artificial intelligence platform built for India’s advocates, law firms and law schools, has begun rolling out more than ten major upgrades to its platform through June. The company says the release is not a feature sprint, but a measured effort to strengthen the one thing legal technology cannot do without: trust.On June 3, 2026, the Supreme Court of India published draft Regulations for Use of Artificial Intelligence in Courts, 2026, prepared under the aegis of its A
